title: An open-world Miami-style crime game with car paint shops and timed races
title_zh: 迈阿密风格开放世界犯罪游戏，含改装店和计时赛
author: ericmaskfr
prompt: you're a senior game dev. build a third-person open-world crime game in a sunny 80s miami-style city. make the loop tight: walk, fight, steal a car, get chased, earn money, spend it. every system feeds the next: crimes bring heat, heat brings cops, missions pay, money unlocks the garage. cars need weight: gears, skids, real crashes. the city has to feel alive with traffic, people and day into night. no audio files, generate every sound in code. after each system, play it yourself, screenshot it and fix what looks wrong. don't stop until a stranger could play for 10 minutes without hitting a bug
post_text:
GTA 6 isn't out yet. Anthropic's new Fable 5.2 already built me one

one prompt. I was not ready for how close it got to the real thing

an indie studio quotes $90,000 and 8 months for a playable prototype like this. Fable 5.2 did it in 2 hours 14 minutes on a $200 plan

what's in there:

→ on foot: sprint, jump, kick, fists, a pistol with real ammo and reloads
→ crime: a witness calls the cops, the stars stack up to 5, police shoot back
→ cars: jack any car, 3 gears, handbrake, headlights, live traffic and crashes
→ garage: 10 paint jobs, bumpers, 5 wheel sets, rim colors and neon underglow, all paid from your balance
→ missions: a 9-checkpoint race on a timer and a courier run that pays $600
→ the city: 9 districts, sunny day into neon night, a minimap, hidden cash that glows green and a pelican on the pier

even the sound is code. every gunshot, engine and siren is generated in python, zero audio files

the prompt:

"you're a senior game dev. build a third-person open-world crime game in a sunny 80s miami-style city. make the loop tight: walk, fight, steal a car, get chased, earn money, spend it. every system feeds the next: crimes bring heat, heat brings cops, missions pay, money unlocks the garage. cars need weight: gears, skids, real crashes. the city has to feel alive with traffic, people and day into night. no audio files, generate every sound in code. after each system, play it yourself, screenshot it and fix what looks wrong. don't stop until a stranger could play for 10 minutes without hitting a bug"

here's what it built ↓

title: Piranha P-7, a code-built 3D fish that takes itself apart
title_zh: Piranha P-7：代码建模、能自拆的 3D 食人鱼
author: Scratcherrrr
post_text:
CLAUDE FABLE 5.2 IS DROPPED. FIRST THING I DID: HANDED IT A 3D PIRANHA THAT TAKES ITSELF APART.

this is Piranha P-7. sculpted with Claude Opus 5.5, finished by Fable 5.2 the day it came out

no 3D model, no Blender. every scale, tooth and rib is code.

how it's made:

1. ONE REFERENCE - SET THE LOOK
a silver sculpt: spiked dorsal crest, underbite, needle teeth, ringed eye

2. CLAUDE - SCULPT IT IN THREE.JS
scales and a lateral line, 47 teeth on two jaws, 6 spined fins, 24 ribs, a skull and a stomach

3. ONE SCRIPT - RUN THE SHOW
jaws open, bite, fins out, shell open, skeleton, stomach scan, frenzy, true colours

4. FABLE 5.2 - THE FINISH
glossy eyes with a catchlight, see-through fins, bubbles, a body that sways in the water

the result?

a 20-second teardown where the stomach scan finds a gold coin and a fishing hook, and the silver fish paints itself into a real red-bellied piranha

what should I make Fable 5.2 build from scratch?

title: A toy-room third-person game with a small explorer collecting items
title_zh: 玩具房第三人称探索小游戏
author: itssotsot
prompt: I want you to create a three.js third-person game where I am Woody from Toy Story inside the house, and I can walk and jump through furniture and objects and find the other characters. Make sure to capture the aesthetic and style of the movie.
post_text:
I built a simple Toy Story-themed game with Fable 5.2, and here's how!

At first, Fable refused to create anything from the Toy Story universe, so it just recreated the styles and it did a damn good job! Look at the lightning, the dust particles, the room itself. How can you not fall in love with something like that? 

Here's the prompt I used:
"I want you to create a three.js third-person game where I am Woody from Toy Story inside the house, and I can walk and jump through furniture and objects and find the other characters. Make sure to capture the aesthetic and style of the movie."
